name: regression-slack
about: The regression from Slack (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-regression-trigger.md). Someone else's '@jarvis-loop regression' is refused. The approver's 'regression web' queues R1 (acknowledged to them only); a second ask while it waits is refused: one at a time. A runner with stage regression takes it, runs the demo repo's scripts/e2e (the stand-in: one pass, one failure with its screenshot) in the fence and reports it: one message in #loop with the counts, the failure's name and assertion, a link to its screenshot and a File it button, and the board's report page shows it all. File it from someone else is refused; the approver's files one item (the screenshot attached) and the report shows it in place of the button; the next run's report of the same failing test shows the open item, not a second File it.

messages.text: ^Sorry, only the approver can do that\.$
